g.text: Split 16 levels into two 4-level parts: how many stable splits can one system have?

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9aa4ae

g.text: There are 3,330 kinds of stable split in all, but no single list of 16 energies makes them all stable at once.

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9aa4ae

g.text: The largest number one list can achieve is proved to lie in the shaded range; its exact value is open.
